'''Redilos''' was the single [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korbin]]. It had a barren and heavily cratered landscape, and [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] very close to the planet, making it appear large in the sky. Redilos was known as '''Redeye''' to the [[Korbin]] natives, because of its bright, [[Color/Legends|dark-red]] glow at night.
